mode: built-in image generation and reference editing

calls.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE exercise-library master frame, FRAME 1 of a six-frame standing bilateral dumbbell curl.
The attached image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER reference, not a pose to copy.
Match this exact canonical athlete's white/light-grey anatomy, bald faceless head, muscular proportions, crisp thin dark contour lines, clean two-dimensional anatomical shading, and white low-top shoes. Same person, not a new design. No photorealism.
Pose: standing tall, both feet flat hip-width apart, neutral knees, level shoulders, torso upright, head neutral. Both upper arms alongside ribs. Both elbows almost straight with approximately 5 degrees flexion, holding two identical modest dark grey round-ended dumbbells just forward of the thighs. Fully supinated grip: palms face forward; wrists straight. Both hands visibly wrapped around the middle of their handles. No swinging.
Camera: fixed almost-front three-quarter view with athlete turned 15 degrees toward image left. Show both arms, both hands and both dumbbells separately and clearly. Portrait canvas 1024 by 1536. Entire head, equipment and shoes inside the frame, comfortable black margins. Feet near the bottom and head near the top; the figure occupies about 90% of image height. Do not rotate the camera toward an exercise side view.
Colour: BOTH BICEPS deep purple #7045F5; brachialis and brachioradialis lighter lilac #C5B5ED; forearm grip and trunk stabilisers very subtle pale purple #E1D8F2. Legs, chest and deltoids remain white-grey. Never enlarge muscles for emphasis. Same line weight and smooth restrained shading as reference.
Fixed scene for subsequent edits: shoe soles, head, shoulders, torso, pelvis and upper arms must remain in exactly the same place and shape. Dumbbells identical size and design. One image only. Solid black background. No text, numbers, captions, arrows, border, collage, grid, logo or UI; the app supplies accessible captions separately. High native resolution, crisp edges.

calls.reviewDecision: Reassigned to the mid-curl slot; too far flexed for the early beat.
